name: Fuyoku no Oracle
source:
A girl is being held captive. A man works behind society's back.
What is her secret?
Their lives cross in this dark fantasy story.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/15649]Freem[/url]]
translation:
一名女孩被俘虏。一个人在社会背后工作。
她的秘密是什么？
他们的生活在这个黑暗奇幻故事中交叉。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/15649]Freem[/url]]
